import openpyxl
import os

IN_XLSX = os.environ['IN_XLSX']
OUT_XLSX = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT_XLSX)
ws = wb.active

# Data structure:
# Columns L-W (12-23), each with phase (row 16) and machine (rows 17,20,23,26)
# Time values in rows 19, 22, 25, 28

# Phase headers (row 16)
phases = {}
for col in range(12, 24):  # L=12 to W=23
    phases[col] = ws.cell(row=16, column=col).value

# Machine rows: 17, 20, 23, 26
# Time rows: 19, 22, 25, 28
machine_rows = [17, 20, 23, 26]
time_rows = [19, 22, 25, 28]

# Compute sums for each machine/phase combination
machines = ['M1', 'M2', 'M3']
phase_cols = {'SETUP': 'C', 'RUN': 'D'}

results = {}
for machine in machines:
    for phase in ['SETUP', 'RUN']:
        total = 0
        for col in range(12, 24):
            if phases[col] != phase:
                continue
            # Check if this column has the machine in any machine row
            for mr, tr in zip(machine_rows, time_rows):
                m_val = ws.cell(row=mr, column=col).value
                if m_val == machine:
                    t_val = ws.cell(row=tr, column=col).value
                    if t_val is not None:
                        # Handle formula cells - evaluate them
                        if isinstance(t_val, str) and t_val.startswith('='):
                            # Simple formula evaluation
                            t_val = eval(t_val.replace('*', '*').replace('+', '+').replace('=', ''))
                        total += t_val
        results[(machine, phase)] = total

print("Results:")
for (machine, phase), val in results.items():
    print(f"  {machine} {phase} = {val}")

# Write to summary cells
# Row 10 = M1, Row 11 = M2, Row 12 = M3
# Col C = SETUP, Col D = RUN
for i, machine in enumerate(machines):
    row = 10 + i
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = results[(machine, 'SETUP')]  # C
    ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = results[(machine, 'RUN')]    # D

wb.save(OUT_XLSX)
print("\nSaved successfully.")
